# FLX-2112: a run id, simulation id or expose id is not a safe identifier

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

A run id is not a name a caller chooses: it is the first 16 hex characters of the plan's own planDigest, so the only well-formed value is 16 lowercase hex digits ([0-9a-f]{16}). Anything else -- a path, a word, an uppercase spelling, a longer or shorter string -- names no run this engine could have written, and `<state_dir>/runs/<run id>` is a path component, so the check runs before the join. `fluxsim plan` prints the value; pass that to --run-id. The same code refuses a run directory whose receipt names a simulation id or an expose id that is not a FLUX identifier (a letter, digit or underscore at each end, dots and hyphens only inside): `verify` and `ship` read both ids back from the receipt, and each becomes part of a file name under the run directory or the golden directory, so an id holding a separator, a leading dot or nothing at all is refused before any path is built. A run `apply` wrote never holds one, because the bundle's schemas pin both ids to the identifier grammar; one that does was edited after `apply`, so run `fluxsim plan` and `fluxsim apply` again.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2112
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
